transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because at work I keep getting up or leaving my station when I’m supposed to stay there. Like in meetings too, I’ll just pop up or start moving before I really think about it. My supervisor said it’s turning into a safety issue, and honestly that’s what made me realize I need to talk to someone.
Did you notice this kind of restlessness and trouble staying seated going back to when you were a child, or is this something that started more recently as an adult?

Yeah, it goes back to when I was a kid. In elementary school I was always the one who couldn’t stay in my seat. I’d get up and wander around the room, talk over the teacher, or blurt stuff out, and notes would get sent home about it. It’s not really new.
Aside from the restlessness and impulsivity, have you noticed a pattern of getting into serious conflicts, breaking rules, or acting aggressively toward others, either now or when you were younger?

No, not really. I mean, I’d get in trouble for moving around or talking when I wasn’t supposed to, but I don’t think of it as serious conflicts or being aggressive. I haven’t really had a pattern of fighting people or breaking rules like that.
Do you also struggle with staying focused on tasks, losing track of details, or forgetting things—like losing items, missing deadlines, or zoning out during conversations?

Yeah, I do. Like when I’m doing inventory logs or trying to read the CNC training pages, I’ll start out really trying to focus, but after a few minutes the numbers or the words just kind of blur together. Then I realize I didn’t really take any of it in, so I have to keep going back over it.
Do you notice this same restlessness and trouble focusing happening in other parts of your life too, like at home or when you're with friends and family, not just at work?

I’m not really sure. I notice it most at work because that’s where it causes problems. At home or with friends, I guess I can get antsy sometimes, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s the same thing.

Can you think of a specific recent example at home—like while watching TV, doing chores, or having a conversation with family—where you noticed yourself getting restless or losing focus, similar to what happens at work?

Yeah, like even at home if I’m supposed to just sit still or wait on something, I get that same feeling. It’s like pressure building up in my body, and I feel like I have to get up right then—pace around, stretch, or go do something. It’s the same kind of feeling I get standing by the machine or sitting through training.
Have you been feeling especially worried, anxious, or on edge lately, separate from the restlessness at work and home?

I don’t think so. I mean, I get frustrated or tense when I can’t sit still or when I’m stuck waiting, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been especially worried or anxious lately. At least not that I’ve really noticed.
Have you ever had a period of several days where you felt unusually energetic, needed much less sleep than normal, or had racing thoughts, along with this restlessness?

I don’t think so. I mean, I have times where I feel restless, but not like several days where I barely sleep and feel unusually energized or anything. I haven’t really noticed racing thoughts like that either.

No evidence of conduct disorder, oppositional defiant traits, anxiety disorder, or bipolar/manic episodes to better explain the presentation.
